hints.title: Majority Character Priority
hints.text: Greedily append the character with the larger remaining count, unless the last two appended characters are already identical to it.

hints.title: Two-Consecutive Character Constraint
hints.text: If the string currently ends in aa, the next character must be b. If it ends in bb, the next character must be a.

hints.title: Simultaneous Length Decrementing
hints.text: While a > 0 or b > 0: if len(res) >= 2 and res[-1] == res[-2] == "a", append "b" and b -= 1. Else if len(res) >= 2 and res[-1] == res[-2] == "b", append "a" and a -= 1. Else if a >= b, append "a" and a -= 1. Else append "b" and b -= 1.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary chunking rules risk leaving a tail of 3 or more identical characters.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single-character greedy selection maintains valid prefixes in linear time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that prioritising the majority character prevents starvation while respecting the 2-in-a-row limit.
complexity.notes: Problem statement guarantees a valid answer always exists.
